system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The assistant() function accepts a goal parameter, which is a natural language command, and intelligently maps it to a series of executable actions.
system_prompt_style.note: Inferred from prose; prompt-building code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The framework is adept at understanding context by analyzing the screen and the application, ensuring that actions are carried out with an awareness of the necessary prerequisites
env_context_strategy.note: Screen analysis plus a semantic router map database injected as context.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Uses minimal vision. Get to know what the user is doing and what is that the user wants to achieve, the assistant plans to perform it.
observation_format.note: core_imaging.py and window_elements.py/ocr.py imply screenshots and UI-element text trees; file tree only.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: To run a JSON test case, modify the JSON path from the "assistant" function.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are produced as JSON test cases; no native tool-calling evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: PyWinAssistant emulates, plans, and simulates synthetic Human-Interface-Device (HID) interactions
edit_primitive.note: GUI-only agent; no file-editing tool listed in the repo file tree.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The framework has a database of a semantic router map to successfully execute generated test cases.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: add your API Key in /core/core_api.py -> line 3: client = OpenAI(api_key='insert_your_api_key_here')
protocol_standardization.note: Only a direct OpenAI client; no MCP/A2A files in the 29-path file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Autonomous systems that decompose tasks, iterate through subgoals, and refine outputs autonomously are key features of Agentic AI paradigms
loop_primitives.note: assistant() plans a case then executes; act()/fast_act() single action.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: To run a JSON test case, modify the JSON path from the "assistant" function.
planning_granularity.note: Generated test case is a stored JSON plan.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: PyWinAssistant has its own set of reasoning agents, utilizing Visualization-of-Thought (VoT) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to enhance generalization and accuracy
multi_agent_topology.note: Multiple specialised reasoning agents in a fixed sequence; could also be read as single.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: PyWinAssistant has its own set of reasoning agents

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Run "Assistant.py", say "Ok computer" to enable the assistant by voice commands or click to it or enable the chat to do a fast action.
human_in_loop.note: Human issues the goal but no per-action approval gate documented.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: allowing for memorization of visual cues and tracking of on-screen changes over time

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Certain components were withheld to comply with AI governance standards, including: Long-term memory
long_term_memory.note: README explicitly says long-term memory was withheld; core/history.db exists in the file tree.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Robust Error Handling and Feedback: The framework is designed to handle unexpected scenarios gracefully, providing clear feedback and ensuring reliability. (In Overview)
self_verification.note: Verification features marked "(In Overview)", i.e. not implemented.

rollback.evidence_quote: PyWinAssistant emulates, plans, and simulates synthetic Human-Interface-Device (HID) interactions
rollback.note: No undo/snapshot facility in the repo file tree.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Utilizes sophisticated algorithms to break down complex tasks into executable steps.
termination_condition.note: Run ends when the generated step list is exhausted; no caps documented.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: add your API Key in /core/core_api.py -> line 3: client = OpenAI(api_key='insert_your_api_key_here')

execution_isolation.note: Runs in-process on the host Windows desktop, driving the real GUI.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Use natural language to operate freely your Windows Operating System.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to the host machine boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Cross-Application Functionality: Seamlessly interfaces with various applications and web services
network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism in the repo file tree.

permission_model.evidence_quote: It's engineered to be modular, understand and execute a wide range of tasks, automating interactions with any desktop applications.

tracing.evidence_quote: For debugging mode execute "Driver.py". Inside it, you can debug and try easily the functions of "act"

replayability.evidence_quote: To run a JSON test case, modify the JSON path from the "assistant" function.
replayability.note: Saved JSON test cases can be re-executed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Generates and plans test cases of your User Interface applications for continuous testing on any Win32api supported application by simply using natural language.
eval_hooks.note: UI test-case generation, but no benchmark evaluation runner in the file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Your own open and secure personal assistant that responds as you want, control the way you want your computer to assist you.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Computer-Using-Agent that fully operates graphical-user-interfaces (GUIs) by using only natural language

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: add your API Key in /core/core_api.py -> line 3: client = OpenAI(api_key='insert_your_api_key_here')
